industry: China's broad vehicle traction-battery manufacturing and automotive supply industry, across battery chemistries and both captive in-house supply and external supply; exclude stationary storage as the target market and starter-only batteries

report_length.count_basis: Count all text inside the seven marked body sections, including subheadings, tables and substantive footnotes. Exclude claim tags, Markdown syntax, link destinations and HTML section markers. Count hyphenated compounds and apostrophe contractions as one word; count numeric expressions as words. Appendices and references must be outside the body.

network_policy: Use the curated local evidence package. No new downloads, browsing, or comprehensive PDF extraction in this acceptance run. Report missing evidence instead.
history_policy: Do not read past reports, force ratings, judgment files, analysis records, closeout conclusions, archived exporters, or historical comparison results. No historical result is a target answer. This English run has no history-comparison command.
source_policy: Chinese original source material, units and original quotations remain available in the evidence package. Write analytical output and report prose in English; retain exact source-language quotations only in the evidence/source appendix or machine-readable mapping, clearly labelled.
missing_value_policy: Keep missing values as null with a reason. Separate direct disclosure, calculations, inferred approximations, source assessments and exclusions for non-comparability. Do not infer precise missing adjusted costs.
submission_status: English acceptance research draft, not a final submission
